claims.claim: The best-performing setup (OpenAI o1-preview with AIDE scaffolding) achieves at least a Kaggle bronze medal in 16.9% of competitions on MLE-bench.
claims.quote: the best-performing setup--OpenAI's o1-preview with AIDE scaffolding--achieves at least the level of a Kaggle bronze medal in 16.9% of competitions

claims.claim: A Claude v3 Opus agent achieves a 37.5% average success rate across tasks in MLAgentBench.
claims.quote: a Claude v3 Opus agent is the best in terms of success rate. It can build compelling ML models over many tasks in MLAgentBench with 37.5% average success rate

claims.claim: Success rates on MLAgentBench vary from 100% on well-established older datasets to 0% on recent Kaggle challenges potentially post-dating LM training.
claims.quote: the success rates vary considerably; they span from 100% on well-established older datasets to as low as 0% on recent Kaggle challenges created potentially after the underlying LM was trained

claims.claim: The best search strategy and operator set increases the success rate of achieving a Kaggle medal on MLE-bench lite from 39.6% to 47.7%.
claims.quote: Our best pairing of search strategy and operator set achieves a state-of-the-art result on MLE-bench lite, increasing the success rate of achieving a Kaggle medal from 39.6% to 47.7%

claims.claim: MLE-STAR achieves medals in 64% of Kaggle competitions on MLE-bench Lite.
claims.quote: MLE-STAR achieves medals in 64% of the Kaggle competitions on the MLE-bench Lite, significantly outperforming the best alternative
